Overview

Myrtle Beach is a city in SC with a population of 37,100. Golf capital with 60 miles of beaches, tourism, and affordable coastal living. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
